title: The Circumgalactic Medium of Submillimeter Galaxies. II. Unobscured QSOs within Dusty Starbursts and QSO Sightlines with Impact Parameters below 100 kpc
question: Are Herschel-selected SMGs near QSOs (5-30 arcsec) true projected SMG-QSO pairs, or are the QSOs hosted by SMGs, and what are the properties of the composites?

data.angular_resolution: ~0.5 arcsec FWHM (clean beams on average 0.56x0.43 arcsec)

what.value: Intrinsic QSO SED template (unobscured PG QSOs)

evidence.loc: 4.1.1 QSO Contribution to the IR Emission
evidence.quote: We adopt the intrinsic QSO SED from (cite: Symeonidis16)
The flux densities have been deboosted using the flux bias table of (cite: Valiante16).

what.value: C IV line widths from the SDSS DR12 Quasar catalog

evidence.loc: 4.2 Properties of the Supermassive Black Holes
evidence.quote: we adopt the line widths in the SDSS Data Release 12 Quasar catalog (cite: Paris16)

what.value: Literature average AGN luminosities of star-forming galaxies at various L_IR

evidence.quote: Then, we show the average AGN luminosities for star-forming galaxies at various IR luminosities from (cite: Fu10), (cite: Rafferty11), and (cite: Chen13).

recipe.method: CASA clean with Briggs weighting, masks, then impbcor

recipe.goal: Detect sources and measure flux, position, size
recipe.method: Search for >4 sigma peaks in SNR maps; fit elliptical Gaussians simultaneously with imfit on non-PB-corrected maps, then correct for primary beam
key_parameters: search primarily within 10 arcsec of field center; uncertainties following Condon97

recipe.goal: Upper limit on undetected QSOs and projected pair statistics
recipe.method: Stack ALMA images at QSO positions; compute expected random pairs using Poisson nearest-neighbor distribution
Compare ALMA vs Herschel 250 um positions; add constant 0.7" to 0.6 FWHM/SNR to enclose 67% of fields

recipe.goal: QSO correction of IR photometry via SED templates
recipe.method: Fit QSO template to SDSS+WISE photometry (plus torus for G15 1450+0026), extrapolate to far-IR to subtract QSO contribution
key_parameters: Torus: QSO template reddened by A_V = 4 mag with Calzetti extinction law
assumptions: Negligible dust-obscured star formation at rest-frame <10 um

recipe.goal: Derive gas/dust mass and surface density
recipe.method: Extrapolate observed 870 um luminosity to rest-frame 850 um with modified blackbody; apply L850/Mgas ratio and gas-to-dust ratio
Fit modified blackbody (optically thick, lambda0 = 150 um, beta = 2) to SPIRE+ALMA photometry; integrate 8-1000 um; SFR = L_IR/1e10 (Kennicutt98, Chabrier IMF)
key_parameters: Redshift fixed (QSO z for composites, 2.5 otherwise)
assumptions: Constant dust temperature, local thermal equilibrium

recipe.goal: BH mass, bolometric luminosity, accretion rate
recipe.method: Virial mass from C IV FWHM and L1350 (Vestergaard & Peterson 2006); L_bol via Hopkins07 correction; Mdot = L_bol/6.3e45 with epsilon=0.1
assumptions: No correction applied for C IV non-virial bias

recipe.goal: Compare growth of BH and galaxies; estimate QSO duty cycle
recipe.method: Compare SFR/Mdot_BH of composites with present-day BH-stellar mass density ratio and literature AGN luminosities
assumptions: 50% recycling of stellar mass; 50% gas fraction; gas exhaustion time 200 Myr

evidence.quote: A total of 39 sources with flux densities between 0.7 mJy $\leq S_{870} \leq 14.4$ mJy are detected in 27 of the 29 ALMA fields.

answer_key.quantity: Herschel sources that are SMGs (S870>2 mJy)

evidence.quote: These observations confirm that 20 of the 29 (69%) *Herschel* sources in our sample are SMGs with $S_{870} > 2$ mJy.

answer_key.quantity: Mean intrinsic source size of 13 resolved high-SNR sources

evidence.quote: The mean source size of those is 0.29$''$$\pm$0.03$''$, where the uncertainty is from bootstrapping.

answer_key.quantity: Stacked 3 sigma upper limit per undetected QSO

evidence.loc: 3.2 Submillimeter Emission from the QSOs and their Host/Companion Galaxies
evidence.quote: The stacking analysis provides a 3$\sigma$ upper limit of $\sim$3.6 mJy per QSO

answer_key.quantity: Expected projected pairs among six Herschel-QSO pairs

evidence.loc: 3.2 Submillimeter Emission from the QSOs and their Host/Companion Galaxies
evidence.quote: Since six of these eight pairs were observed by ALMA, we expect only $1.4\pm1.0$ projected pairs
18 of the 27 fields (67%) show ALMA positions within 4.22$''$$\pm$0.14$''$ of the *Herschel* position

answer_key.quantity: Mean SFR surface density of SMG-QSO composites

evidence.loc: 4.1.3 IR Luminosity and SFR Surface Density
evidence.quote: The mean SFR surface density of the SMG-QSO composites is $\sim$260 $M_{\odot}$ yr$^{-1}$ kpc$^{-2}$.

evidence.loc: 4.1.2 Mass and Surface Density of the Interstellar Medium

evidence.loc: 4.2 Properties of the Supermassive Black Holes
evidence.quote: The estimated BH accretion rates range between 2 and 7 $M_{\odot}$ yr$^{-1}$, with Eddington ratios between 10 and 30%

answer_key.quantity: BH accretion fraction of total bolometric luminosity
